sections.heading: D — Accuracy and Verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Sixteen Emergencies and roadside assistance

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Sixteen Emergencies and roadside assistance dossier. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited physical handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition, and every number is spelled out in words so that the card backs read aloud exactly. The extracted text of these pages carries a font-encoding shift that garbles scattered words and the Courtesy Patrol telephone number into offset characters and turns commas into line breaks; the dossier author decoded the letter shift deterministically, omitted the telephone number because it stayed unreadable, and read the two emergency kit lists column by column. Physical page eighty-six holds no extractable text and is not cited. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or question is reproduced. Penalty amounts are stated as the pinned edition prints them; no time-variable fact beyond that edition appears, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Sixteen Emergencies and roadside assistance content changes at most with a new edition.
